text:
rina: PSA: someone microwaved fish yesterday and the whole kitchen smelled like the sea. can we have a "no fish in shared microwave" sign? :pray:

chao: ugh, that was me, apologies. didn't realize it would be so intense. i'll clean the microwave today.

kitchen-bot: [air-quality] kitchen_odor_level=high at 2026-04-02T09:12Z

sam: sign is a good idea. i'll design a cute sticker: 'No Fish, No Foul' with a tiny whale.

ivy: love the sticker. also maybe a microwave lid policy? cover containers or use takeout boxes.

rina: microwave lid policy + sign. sam, can you drop off 10 disposable microwavable lids? i'll reimburse.

sam: will do after lunch. getting lids + bag of coffee beans.

chao: cleaning update: microwave scrubbed, deodorized with lemon + baking soda. leaving note in binder. sorry again.

rina: thanks chao. all forgiven if you bring cookies tomorrow. :cookie:
